result.summary: The screen is broadly functional but has several visual defects: the promo banner's text is nearly illegible due to white-on-light-green contrast, horizontally scrolling rows are awkwardly clipped mid-card, restaurant names are truncated without proper handling, and favorite-button styling is inconsistent between cards.

issues.description: The '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner uses white text on a very light mint green background, producing extremely low contrast for both the headline and the subtitle ('Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10'), making it hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark green/near-black color (or darken the banner background) so contrast meets at least 4.5:1.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card ('Trattoria Piccol…') is cut off flush at the screen edge with its title truncated and no ellipsis or peek gutter, so it reads as broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add trailing padding/peek so the next card is partially visible, and apply text ellipsis (or wrap) to card titles.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the next chip with no visual affordance that it scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding and a fade/gradient edge or arrow indicator to signal that more categories are available.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20%) is abruptly cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible name, rating or bottom padding, making the list look truncated.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the nav bar height so the last card can scroll fully into view.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white circle with dark outline on the ramen card, dark circle with white outline on the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button treatment (e.g. semi-transparent dark scrim with white icon) across all cards.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while sibling cards use dark imagery, so the row looks visually unbalanced and its white time badge nearly blends in.
issues.suggestion: Normalize image treatment (consistent overlay/scrim) and ensure badges have sufficient contrast on light images.

issues.description: Section 'See all' links sit very close to the clipped card edge and the third card's delivery text ('€1.90 delivery') is also cut, giving an unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Constrain card widths so text fits within the viewport and add consistent 16px horizontal margins.
